verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs clearly show the browser extension creating, saving and signing in with passkeys. For TOTP, the docs only say 1Password stores one-time passwords and lets you access them quickly; nothing states the extension autofills those codes at login. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP autofill in the browser extension, independent or hands-on corroboration of passkey and TOTP autofill during login.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them

citations.quote: you can now create, manage, and sign in with passkeys on a growing number of websites and apps directly from the 1Password browser extension
You can use 1Password to save the passkeys you create for your accounts and sign in to websites with passkeys in your browser.
Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
1Password lets you easily sign in to sites, use suggested passwords, and find what you need – all without leaving your browser.
